en.title: A Tale of the Moon, the Silver Bell, and the Magic Bakery
en.premise: In a small bakery nestled in the Land of Clouds, there is a special magic that bakes delicious bread by listening to stories. One day, a hungry traveler who has forgotten their own name—the 'Nameless Cat'—visits the shop. Vowing to reach the 'Hill of Promise' to reunite with someone precious, the cat sets off on a journey in search of gentle magic, accompanied by the bakery's own tiny Spoon-kun.

zh.title: 月亮、银铃与魔法面包店的故事
zh.premise: 在云之国的一家小面包店里，有着一种通过倾听故事来烘焙美味面包的魔法。某一天，一只忘记了名字、饥肠辘辘的“无名猫先生”来到了店里。为了有一天能与重要的人相遇，猫先生约定前往“约定之丘”。于是，他与面包店的小勺子君一起，为了寻找温柔的魔法而踏上了旅程。

prediction_results.question: 旅の始まり。二人が最初に出会うものは？
